title: Kurash
tagline: Tug them off balance, ride the swing, throw.
description: Kurash, the belt wrestling of Uzbekistan, with real wrestlers on a round mat. Move a thumb to tug and set your rival's weight swinging, then flick and lift to throw for chala, yonbosh or a perfect halal. Five rivals, three venues, two players on one phone, or watch and learn.
howToPlay: Move a thumb anywhere: the way it moves is the way you pull your rival.
Tug in time with their swing so it grows and grows.
Flick and lift your thumb to throw the way they lean.
Chala 1 point, yonbosh 2, halal wins the bout at once.
Hold still to root and defend, but passive wrestlers are warned.
